title: Custodian
description:
About Our Company:
Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position
We are seeking a dependable, proactive Custodian to help maintain a clean, safe, and professional data center environment that supports daily operations, audit readiness, and customer confidence. This role is responsible for routine janitorial services across common areas, offices, hallways, and support spaces, as well as grounds maintenance, seasonal weather support, waste handling, and common-area supply readiness.
This role goes beyond basic housekeeping. You will help ensure the facility remains orderly, accessible, and presentable in a live, customer-facing, mission-critical environment. You will coordinate work with Operations to avoid disrupting site activity, support recycling and waste management practices, assist with ESG-related documentation, and help maintain safe exterior conditions during changing weather.
Help keep a mission-critical environment clean, safe, accessible, and customer-ready every day.
Shift: Monday-Friday (7am-3pm)
department: Data Center Operations - Opérations de centre de données

title: Généraliste RH
description:
Notre compagnie:
Basée à Denver, au Colorado, Cologix est une entreprise chef de file en Amérique du Nord dans le domaine de l’interconnexion neutres réseaux et des centres de données edge hyperscale. Notre plateforme offre à nos clients un accès à plus de 45 centres de données numérique edge et hyperscale edge  Scalelogix℠ répartis dans 13 marchés aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu’à un écosystème à forte densité de connectivité comprenant plus de 710 réseaux, plus de 360 fournisseurs de cloud, plus de 35 rampes d’accès (onramps) et sept points d’échange Internet.
Nous offrons à près de 2 000 clients un accès direct à nos équipes opérationnelles locales, favorisant ainsi des partenariats solides appuyés par un soutien opérationnel exceptionnel et un service à la clientèle exemplaire. Soutenue par l’un des plus importants fonds d’infrastructure en Amérique du Nord, l’équipe de direction chevronnée de Cologix, son personnel certifié et son engagement envers les initiatives ESG contribuent à créer une culture qui valorise nos employés, notre environnement et nos clients.

À propos du poste :
Nous recherchons un professionnel des ressources humaines compétent, doté d’un esprit stratégique et soucieux du détail, pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance. Sous la supervision du gestionnaire senior, partenaire d’affaires en RH, le généraliste en ressources humaines jouera un rôle clé dans la mise en œuvre d’un large éventail de programmes et de services RH, notamment en dirigeant les communications au sein du service, en gérant les programmes de gestion des congés, en soutenant les relations avec les employés, en faisant progresser les initiatives stratégiques en matière de RH et en veillant au respect des politiques organisationnelles et des exigences de conformité.
En tant que ressource de confiance pour les employés de toute l’organisation, le généraliste en ressources humaines adoptera une approche fortement axée sur le service afin de fournir des conseils opportuns et précis sur les politiques, les procédures et les programmes RH, ainsi que sur un large éventail de questions liées aux employés.

description:
About Our Company:
Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position
We are seeking a dependable, professional Data Center Security Guard to execute frontline physical security controls within a 24x7 mission-critical data center environment. This role is responsible for protecting facility assets, personnel, customers, and critical infrastructure through disciplined access control, surveillance monitoring, patrols, incident response, and life-safety support.
This is a highly visible, real-time operations role. You will verify identities, control visitor access, monitor cameras and alarms, conduct patrols, document incidents, and respond to security-related events in accordance with established procedures. You will also support shipping and receiving controls, maintain accurate logs, and act as a first responder within the limits of your training during emergencies. This role is ideal for someone who is alert, composed, service-oriented, and committed to consistent execution in a secure environment.
Protect the people, assets, and access points that keep a mission-critical facility secure.
Shift: 2nd shift (Mon-Fri: 2pm - 12 am)
